summary_1line: Yudhishthira asks which Brahmana deserves gifts more; Bhishma teaches that gifts to learned, content, non‑begging Brahmanas yield the greatest merit.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma lies on his bed of arrows while Yudhishthira stands beside him listening as the old warrior speaks of gifts to humble, non‑begging Brahmanas.
A humble Brahmana who refuses to beg sits quietly in poverty as a king respectfully approaches to offer gifts of cattle, gold, and robes.
Hungry children wait at home while a Brahmana returns carrying food given by a generous householder for his expectant family.
